# Omnipad

> Omnipad is a free Android app that turns a phone into a wireless keyboard, mouse, trackpad, presentation remote, macro pad and TV remote. It connects over Bluetooth with nothing installed on the other device, or over Wi-Fi/USB with the Omnipad desktop app for Linux.

## Key facts

- Platform: Android 9 or newer (phone app). Optional desktop app: Linux.
- Price: The keyboard (with number pad and function keys) and trackpad are free with no account, over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi/USB with the desktop app. Pro (presenter and slide clicker, media and TV remote, gamepad, all tile boards and unlimited tiles, voice typing, type clipboard, air mouse and air pointer, volume-key slides, talk timer, scan to type, jiggler) unlocks for 30 minutes per rewarded video ad (up to 2 hours), or with a Monthly, Yearly or Lifetime plan that also removes ads.
- Bluetooth mode works with: Windows 10/11, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, iPad/iPhone (mouse via AssistiveTouch), Android phones and tablets, Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV and most smart TVs.
- Desktop app adds: Wi-Fi and USB connections, now-playing info with album art and seek bar (MPRIS), and a virtual Xbox 360 controller.
- Keyboard layout: text is sent for US English; set the target to US English for typing.
- Limitation: a few phone makers disable Android's Bluetooth keyboard (HID device) feature; Wi-Fi/USB still works on those phones.

## Features

- Trackpad: tap to click, two-finger scroll with momentum, two/three-finger tap for right/middle click, tap-and-drag, drag lock.
- Air mouse: gyroscope pointer, works with the phone held flat or upright.
- Keyboard: live typing, Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Super modifiers (tap = one shot, hold = lock), arrows, Home/End, PgUp/PgDn, F1–F12, number pad, voice dictation, type phone clipboard.
- Presenter: Next/Previous buttons and swipe, volume buttons change slides, start / start from here / black screen / end for PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote, LibreOffice Impress and PDF viewers, hold-to-point air pointer, talk timer with vibration at 2 minutes left and at time up, keeps screen on.
- Tiles and macros: boards of custom buttons; each tile runs steps (key combination, type text, wait, mouse click, scroll, media key, hold key, release key); repeat while held; templates for Essentials, Browser, Coding (VS Code), Meetings (Meet/Zoom/Teams), Windows, macOS, Media and OBS; share boards as JSON.
- Media and TV remote: play/pause, next, previous, volume, mute, D-pad, OK, Back, Home, Menu.
- Tools: barcode/QR scan to type, mouse jiggler (keeps the computer awake), Bluetooth gamepad.

## Common questions

- How do I use my phone as a mouse for my PC without installing anything? Install Omnipad, choose Bluetooth, tap "Make phone visible", then pair the phone from the PC's Bluetooth settings.
- Can Omnipad be a PowerPoint clicker? Yes, the Present tab; the phone's volume buttons can change slides.
- Can Omnipad control a smart TV? Yes, any TV that accepts a Bluetooth keyboard.
